tests.title: Password login survives relaunch
tests.description: Logs in with the embedded password flow, relaunches the app without resetting state, and verifies the authenticated session is restored.

tests.title: Embedded SAML login succeeds
tests.description: Opens the embedded SAML flow, completes the mock Okta SAML handoff, and verifies the SAML user is signed in.

tests.title: Embedded OIDC login succeeds
tests.description: Opens the embedded OIDC flow, completes the mock Okta OIDC handoff, and verifies the OIDC user is signed in.

tests.title: Embedded step-up routes to the MFA challenge
tests.description: Logs in, starts a native step-up (acr_values + max_age), and verifies the StepUpWebDriver seeds the box's step-up localStorage contract and rewrites the URL to the /account/step-up route so the hosted box renders its MFA challenge instead of a blank page, then completes the challenge and verifies the app reports step-up success.

tests.title: Request authorize flow signs in seeded user
tests.description: Seeds the request-authorize token, starts the authorize flow, and verifies the seeded signup user is authenticated.

tests.title: Custom SSO browser handoff returns to app
tests.description: Starts the custom SSO browser flow, completes the mock IdP handoff, and verifies the custom SSO user is signed in.

tests.title: Direct social browser handoff returns to app
tests.description: Starts the direct social browser flow, completes the mock social provider handoff, and verifies the social user is signed in.

tests.title: Cold launch probe timeouts do not blink no-connection UI
tests.description: Queues transient startup probe timeouts and verifies the app stays on the login experience without flashing the no-connection screen.

tests.title: Post-logout relaunch transient probe failure does not blink no-connection UI
tests.description: Logs out, queues transient startup probe failures, relaunches, and verifies the app returns to the login experience without flashing the no-connection screen.

tests.title: Authenticated relaunch enters offline mode when the network path is unavailable
tests.description: Logs in, relaunches with the network path forced offline, and verifies the existing session stays available with authenticated offline indicators and no retry UI.

tests.title: Expired access token refreshes on authenticated relaunch
tests.description: Configures a short-lived access token, relaunches after expiry, and verifies the token refreshes successfully without entering offline mode.

tests.title: Offline mode recovers to online and refreshes the token
tests.description: Forces a refresh failure plus probe failures near expiry, verifies authenticated offline mode is entered, then verifies recovery back online with a refreshed token.

tests.title: Offline mode keeps the user signed in until reconnect refreshes an expired token
tests.description: Forces a prolonged offline window, lets the access token expire while offline, verifies the user stays signed in, and verifies reconnect refreshes the token successfully.

tests.title: Custom SSO recovers after a transient no-connection relaunch
tests.description: Logs out, relaunches through a transient no-connection state if it appears, then completes custom SSO and verifies the user is signed in again.

tests.title: Cold launch with offline mode disabled reaches login quickly
tests.description: Queues probe failures, launches with enableOfflineMode=false, and verifies the app reaches the login screen quickly without showing offline or no-connection UI.

tests.title: Offline mode disabled preserves session during connection loss and recovers
tests.description: Logs in with enableOfflineMode=false, terminates, queues connection drops, relaunches, verifies the session is preserved without offline indicators, then verifies the profile is restored when connection returns.

tests.title: Password login works with offline mode disabled
tests.description: Launches with enableOfflineMode=false and completes a password login, confirming normal auth flows are unaffected.

tests.title: Cold start with expired access token and transient probe failure preserves session
tests.description: Logs in with enableOfflineMode=false, terminates, waits past access-token expiry, queues a single probe failure, and relaunches — verifies the session is preserved instead of being wiped by the network gate (regression test for the FCM-cold-start bug).

tests.title: Cold start with expired access token and transient probe failure preserves session
tests.description: Logs in with enableOfflineMode=false, terminates, waits past access-token expiry, queues a single probe failure, and relaunches — verifies the session is preserved instead of being wiped by the network gate (regression test for the FCM-cold-start bug).

tests.title: Logout clears session so relaunch shows login
tests.description: Logs in, logs out, terminates, relaunches without reset, and verifies the login page appears (keychain cleared by logout).

tests.title: Expired refresh token clears session and shows login
tests.description: Logs in with a very short refresh token TTL, waits for both tokens to expire, relaunches, and verifies the app clears credentials and shows login.

tests.title: Scheduled token refresh fires before expiry
tests.description: Logs in with a short access token TTL and verifies the SDK's scheduled refresh fires automatically, incrementing the token version while the app stays in the foreground.

tests.title: Relaunch with expired access token refreshes via valid refresh token
tests.description: Logs in with a very short access TTL, terminates after access expires but before refresh expires, relaunches, and verifies the token is refreshed.

tests.title: DPoP proof signs the authorization code exchange
tests.description: With DPoP enabled, logs in with the embedded password flow and verifies the code exchange POST /oauth/token carries one DPoP proof: typ dpop+jwt, ES256, a public P-256 EC jwk without a private part, htm POST, htu ending with /oauth/token, a jti, a current iat, no ath, and a signature that verifies with its jwk.

tests.title: DPoP refresh reuses the device key without the bound token
tests.description: With DPoP enabled and a short access TTL, waits for the scheduled refresh and verifies its proof has the same jwk thumbprint as the code exchange, a new jti and a valid signature, that the cnf-bound access token is not sent on the refresh, and that the refreshed bound token is then used with the DPoP scheme.

tests.title: DPoP-bound access token uses the DPoP scheme on resource calls
tests.description: With DPoP enabled the mock binds the issued access token to the proof key (cnf.jkt); verifies GET /identity/resources/users/v2/me sends Authorization: DPoP, never Bearer, with a proof from the same key whose htm, htu and ath (SHA-256 of the access token) match.

tests.title: DPoP nonce challenge is retried once with the server nonce
tests.description: The mock answers the first code exchange with 400 use_dpop_nonce and a DPoP-Nonce header; verifies the SDK retries exactly once with that nonce in a fresh proof, signs in, and keeps sending the remembered nonce on later proofs to the same host.

tests.title: DPoP disabled sends no proofs
tests.description: With DPoP disabled, logs in and waits for a scheduled refresh, then verifies no request carried a DPoP header and resource calls keep the Bearer scheme.

tests.title: DPoP key rotates on logout
tests.description: With DPoP enabled, logs in, logs out, logs in again and verifies the second code exchange proof uses a different jwk thumbprint than the first, so the logged-out session's key is gone.

tests.title: Play Integrity unavailable fails open
tests.description: With a Play Integrity project number set on an emulator without the Play Store, logs in with the embedded password flow and waits for a scheduled refresh, verifying sign-in and refresh succeed and no request carries the frontegg-device-integrity-token header.

tests.title: Play Integrity disabled sends no integrity token
tests.description: With no Play Integrity project number, logs in and verifies no request carries the frontegg-device-integrity-token header.

tests.title: Play Integrity attests the code exchange but not the refresh
tests.description: Replaces Play Integrity with a fake provider that issues tokens bound to the request hash, logs in and waits for a scheduled refresh, and verifies the authorization code exchange carries the token for its body while the refresh and every other request carry none.

tests.title: StateFlow user state shows the signed-in email
tests.description: Verifies the login page markers collected from isAuthenticated.stateFlow and user.stateFlow read false and no user, logs in with the embedded password flow, and verifies the Home markers show true and the user's email.

tests.title: StateFlow auth state clears after logout
tests.description: Logs in, verifies the user.stateFlow marker shows the email, logs out, and verifies the login page returns with the isAuthenticated.stateFlow marker reading false and the user.stateFlow marker cleared.

tests.title: StateFlow access token updates after a token refresh
tests.description: Logs in with a short access token TTL and verifies the marker collected from accessToken.stateFlow moves to the refreshed token version after the scheduled refresh, matching the polled access token marker.

tests.title: Compose tenant switcher switches the active tenant
tests.description: Logs in as a user with three tenants, opens the Compose components screen, verifies FronteggTenantSwitcher lists every tenant and marks the active one, taps another tenant, and verifies the PUT tenant switch request and that the switcher and user state move to the new tenant.

tests.title: Compose security center revokes one session
tests.description: Opens FronteggSecurityCenter, verifies it lists the current and two other sessions, signs out one of them, and verifies the DELETE request for that session only and that its row disappears.

tests.title: Compose security center signs out other sessions
tests.description: Opens FronteggSecurityCenter, taps Sign out other sessions, and verifies DELETE requests for every non-current session, none for the current one, and that only this device's session stays listed.

tests.title: Compose security center sign out returns to login
tests.description: Opens FronteggSecurityCenter, taps Sign out, and verifies the logout request and that the app returns to the login page with the auth state cleared.
